ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Set`, which initialises its local `reps` to 0, and `Counting` inside it.
A press: `reps` becomes 1 and the display `shown` copies it.
`rest` leaves `Set` for `Resting`. `shown` is an output and keeps its value, 2.
A press starts the next set: `Set` is entered again, so `reps` is initialised to 0 again. This press does not count as a rep: `Counting` was entered in this tick, and its transition is delayed.
The first rep of the new set: `reps` is 1, not 3. Every entry of `Set` starts from scratch.
